scope: Refresh current LibreDWG pull-request state for previously mapped parser-safety, count, discriminator, string, and class-dispatch proposals.
Reconfirm BRL-CAD POLYFACE issue and proposed-fix status and distinguish proposal recovery behavior from DXF requirements.
Cross-check the specific peer mechanisms against the current local AcDs marker scan, SAB pre-scan input cap, and signed POLYFACE validation.
Confirm the official OCCT component product boundary for DXF and ACIS import/export.
Add a condition-triggered peer-research stop rule without changing implementation order, validation cadence, or support claims.

sources.name: LibreDWG open pull-request list
sources.evidence: The current open queue lists proposals covering AcDs marker-scan bounds, checked vector-size products, tagged/union identity, count-to-array consistency, modern DXF TV/TU field typing, and class/type dispatch. These are unmerged proposals, not release behavior.

sources.name: LibreDWG AcDs scan proposal #1453
sources.evidence: The open proposal describes a peer size_t subtraction-underflow path in an AcDs ACIS-marker scan near the decompressed buffer boundary.

sources.name: BRL-CAD issue #228 and proposed PR #245
sources.evidence: The issue remains open and reports unvalidated POLYFACE face indices in dxf-g; the proposed bounds-checking fix remains an open pull request with no review recorded on the inspected page. Its invalid-triangle skip behavior is a peer proposal, not a format contract.

sources.name: Official OCCT components preview README
sources.evidence: The repository identifies itself as a public preview/documentation hub for commercial OCCT extensions and lists DXF Import-Export and ACIS Import-Export as components obtained through its store.

sources.name: Local source cross-check
sources.evidence: AcDs marker scanning is bounded to complete markers inside the retained payload; SAB input size is rejected before signature discovery; POLYFACE signed indices are checked against the actual coordinate-record count before DXF writing. These local checks address only the named mechanisms and are not an exhaustive safety proof.

method.kind: Read-only internet primary-source review and local source/plan audit
method.limitations: GitHub PR and issue pages are mutable status views. The proposal contents are peer evidence, not DWG/DXF normative sources or proof of corresponding local defects. The local source checks are specific to the reviewed mechanisms; no exhaustive parser audit or runtime qualification was performed.

localCrosswalk.peerProposalOwners: Reuse existing PAR-14/PAR-20/7S/7V and class-dispatch work; keep the scheduled bounded arithmetic census at its owning checkpoint and do not port unmerged peer code.
localCrosswalk.polyface: Reuse 7V/PAR-37 signed one-based index, negative invisible-edge, zero-termination, stale-count, and out-of-range refusal controls. Keep BRL-CAD out of hostile-vector qualification until a merged revision is reviewed and pinned.
localCrosswalk.acdsAndSab: Local marker bounds and pre-scan input cap address the specific peer scan mechanism only; preserve them and do not infer a general ACIS/AcDs support or security claim.
localCrosswalk.occt: Stock open-source OCCT is not an independent DXF or ACIS reader/kernel lane based on the official component catalog. Any separately licensed extension remains a distinct commercial artifact lane.
localCrosswalk.researchTrigger: Reopen external peer status research only when a cited change merges or ships in a pinned artifact, changes the route/version matrix, or a touched local owner lacks its planned invariant/control.
localCrosswalk.implementationCadence: Continue local generated fast controls, strict touched-target builds, owning focused CTest, and scoped diff/receipt checks per slice; keep peer builds, sanitizers, long fuzzing, native CAD, and independent ACIS/kernel work at scheduled composed checkpoints.
localCrosswalk.externalEvidence: J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
